dashboard.description: Slice and dice pfSense filterlog events.

| inputlookup pfsense_filter_app | stats count by app | sort app | eval app_value=app, app_label=app | append [| makeresults | eval app_value="*", app_label="All"] | eval sort_key=if(app_value="*", "0", "1") | sort sort_key app_label | fields app_label app_value
